description: Reviewed execution policies; recognition database categories do not authorize caching or cookie issuance. Consumer flags preserve existing defaults.

policies.description: User Switching 1.12.2 plain, secure and old-user authentication cookies select the personal switch-back region. Basic passes matching requests; UltraCache isolates the actual provider return link in a request-owned private fragment.
Drupal HTTPS session cookie. The default is Private in both profiles; an explicit Shared HTML or Public variant choice uses the ordinary scoped cookie resolver.
Drupal HTTP session cookie. The default is Private in both profiles; an explicit Shared HTML or Public variant choice uses the ordinary scoped cookie resolver.
PrestaShop combined encrypted cookie can contain customer identity, authentication and cart state. The default is Private in both profiles; the site can explicitly select another action.
Joomla sets this login marker to logged_in after site login and deletes it on logout. The default is Private in both profiles; the selected cookie action remains overrideable.
Joomla uses this cookie to initiate remembered authentication. The default is Private in both profiles; the selected cookie action remains overrideable.

Browser capability marker for UltraCache ESI mini-cart support. It contains no customer or session identity. Actual provider/session inputs remain separate. Shared by default in both profiles; administrator Shared, Variant and Private choices remain authoritative.
